title: The birth of a concept: Button and Door
figure: Theoria.md:416 -- 图 6 概念诞生时间线 (a concept from evidence to admission, timestamped)
claim: Two of the framework's own admission criteria disagree on the first cold start. Compression (Theoria 1.8 / constraint 5) says reject the Button and the Door; full-frame responsibility (constraint 2) says they must exist or frame 0 fails. Responsibility won, and the compression account was later re-based rather than overruled.

timeline.event: 43 static cells, 38 dynamic, background colour 0; cell (4,5) is the one cell in the divider the board refuses to explain
two operators priced; uniform-colour wins on script length
three tracks; obj0 present in 276 frames, obj1 in 100, obj2 in 276; 214 move events (all obj2), 1 recolor (obj0), 1 vanish (obj1)
compression account comes back negative for Button and Door; admitted anyway on constraint 2
press_left and door_opens_left, coverage 1/1 each, identical guard, both witnessed at transition 99
zero_space returns the Button-Door dependency as a GF(2) conservation law with 275 transitions of support
one pass over all 28 candidates plus the board map produces the whole manual: 3 objects, 7 rules, 2 invariants, 1 pending theorem
compression re-based against a responsibility-complete alternative; Button -17 -> -5, Door -13 -> -1, all three objects mandatory on expressibility

first_seen_to_first_use.note: Theoria.md:94 asks 首见到首用隔了几步. Both concepts are visible from frame 0 (the Button in all 276 frames); each has exactly one event, at transition 99, out of 275.

compression_accounts.note: Two accountings of the same three objects. The pixel baseline is what the log adjudicated against; the responsibility-complete baseline is the correction A0_REPORT recommended and the artefact now carries.

responsibility_complete_baseline.reason_field: a law names it (invariant door_latch / cart_unique) and the invariant language has no pixel-level paraphrase

compression_accounts.unreconciled: The per-object script bits differ by exactly 4 between the two tables (2169/29/25 vs 2165/25/21). The two are different accountings and neither report claims they should agree, but the uniform 4-bit offset is not explained anywhere on the tree.

says_reject.text: 一个概念入册的资格 = 它让说明书变短

says_admit.text: 每个像素要么属棋盘、要么属某个对象,说明书没解释的像素就是意外

constraint.text: 规划前全史重放——升级为双重对账(转移重放 + 渲染一致性,全帧责任制)

framework_criteria_in_collision.why: the two pixels (3,2) and (4,5) change, so the board cannot own them; unowned pixels are an anomaly at frame 0; and the Door's rule cannot be stated without the Button in the vocabulary

caveats: The seal has a hole: one instance built the A0 world at M1 and adjudicated it at M3 (cold-start-a0/THEORIZE_LOG.md:11-19).
A2's theorize step was done by hand, so the reproduction is of the criterion collision, not of an independent theorizer (cold-start-a2/A2_REPORT.md:271-273).
Every world here has fewer than 60 reachable states; the corrected baseline is not validated at scale.
